long_biography.plain_text:
Clivedale places Sameer Gehlaut at the centre of London's super-prime property market. He founded the Mayfair-based developer, which undertakes residential, commercial and hotel projects and has delivered branded residences in central London. He is its controlling shareholder, with authority over voting and director appointments.

GB Bank adds a different current responsibility. Gehlaut is its majority shareholder and an investor director representing Hera Holdings, while an executive team runs day-to-day banking. The bank specialises in savings and property-backed lending for developers and smaller businesses. His board seat couples invested capital with governance of a regulated lender.

[2] Clivedale: Clivedale is the Mayfair-based super-prime property developer Gehlaut founded and continues to control. [3] Controlling investor: Gehlaut exercises controlling ownership over Clivedale and GB Bank and retains a significant promoter interest in the restructured Indiabulls platform. [4] Corporate banking: GB Bank lends to property developers and smaller businesses, giving Gehlaut a current ownership and governance association with business banking. [5] Financial-services entrepreneur: Gehlaut created and scaled financial businesses across online brokerage, housing finance and later bank ownership rather than entering finance solely as a passive investor. [6] Founder-controlled public company: Gehlaut co-founded Indiabulls, took the business public and led it as executive chairman during its expansion into multiple financial and property businesses. [7] Founder-to-investor transition: After two decades as Indiabulls' founder-operator, Gehlaut reduced or exited legacy holdings and shifted toward controlling ownership and board-level investment governance across Clivedale and GB Bank. [8] GB Bank: GB Bank is the British property-focused lender in which Gehlaut is majority shareholder and an investor director through Hera Holdings. [9] Indiabulls: Indiabulls is the online-brokerage and financial-services group Gehlaut co-founded, took public and led as executive chairman for two decades; he retains a promoter interest in its restructured current company. [10] Indiabulls Housing Finance: The former Indiabulls Housing Finance was a major lending business Gehlaut founded and formerly promoted before reducing his stake and separating from current governance. [11] Mortgage lending: Housing finance and home lending were major components of Indiabulls' growth under Gehlaut and contributed materially to his original fortune. [12] Online securities brokerage: Gehlaut's original wealth engine was the online brokerage from which Indiabulls expanded into a broader financial-services group. [13] Public-market listings: Gehlaut took Indiabulls public, creating the capital-markets platform from which the group expanded into lending and property. [14] Serial entrepreneurship: Gehlaut co-founded Indiabulls, later founded Clivedale and assembled further banking and investment interests across India and Britain. [15] Commercial real estate: Commercial property is one of the three stated development sectors of Gehlaut's controlling Clivedale platform in London.
